claims.text: Chemo given with radiation (cisplatin or carboplatin) is often used to sensitize the tumor to radiation
claims.quote: Chemotherapy (cisplatin or carboplatin) is usually given with radiation therapy, often to sensitize the tumor to radiation.
claims.locator: Stages IB3, IIA2, IIB, III, and IVA

claims.text: Recurrent, persistent or metastatic disease: cisplatin + paclitaxel or topotecan + paclitaxel; adding bevacizumab improved median overall survival by 3.7 mo
claims.quote: In a randomized trial, adding bevacizumab to combination chemotherapy (cisplatin plus paclitaxel or topotecan plus paclitaxel) resulted in an improvement of 3.7 months in median overall survival in patients with recurrent, persistent, or metastatic cervical cancer (11).

claims.text: Adding pembrolizumab to chemo improved progression-free and overall survival in persistent, recurrent or metastatic disease
claims.quote: In a randomized, placebo-controlled trial, adding pembrolizumab to chemotherapy, improved progression-free and overall survival in patients with persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer (13).
